answer_1.quote: We consider three goals: (a) average performance in generation of pages, (b) variance of performance in generation of pages across users, and (c) performance on outcome prediction...
answer_1.outputs: Sequences of page URLs (tokens) representing the next browsing session

answer_2.quote: We use a broad set of metrics ... (1) Variance metrics in page generation ... (2) Page generation metrics are aligned with prior work on language models ... (3) Outcome prediction metrics (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1) ... We also report BLEU and BERT‑based scores.
